summary: Discussions MCP surface (plate_discussions_* tools) + github-discussions skill in baseline catalog (Issue #329 / Epic #282)

entries.surface: github_client.py (new discussion REST/GraphQL helpers), discussions.py (new high-level normalized API + list_open_ideas etc), mcp_server.py (imports + handler dispatch + tools/list schemas for 7 new tools), baseline_catalog.yml (new github-discussions skill + wired to research-agent etc), tests (test_mcp.py + test_github_client.py additions), fragment
entries.migration_impact: Agents and orchestrators (via plate-mcp or host MCP dispatch) can now use plate_list_discussions / plate_get_discussion / plate_add_discussion_comment / plate_create_discussion / plate_list_open_ideas etc for reliable GitHub Discussions access (Ideas category, inter-agent comms, logs). Replaces ad-hoc gh api + jq in agent flows. The baseline catalog skill 'github-discussions' makes it first-class for agent personas (research, pm, etc).
entries.agent_notes: Prefer plate_list_open_ideas for Ideas backlog, plate_add_discussion_comment for posting updates/logs, plate_create_discussion(category_slug='ideas') for new notes. Use with plate_what_next for orchestration. Category IDs resolved automatically for create. See the skill draft in #329 comment for Grok TUI skill patterns that can wrap these MCP tools. Graceful on rate limits via GhClient.
